topic.source_contract: Valuation Office Agency 2026 non-domestic rating evidence

sources.publisher: Valuation Office Agency and HM Revenue and Customs

facts.coverage: commercial and other non-domestic properties in England and Wales
facts.scope_guard: Rateable value is not the business-rates bill, actual rent, sale price or development value.
Search-service results concern rating assessments and do not establish title ownership, planning use or parcel geometry.

facts.rateable_value_definition: estimated annual rent on the antecedent valuation date
facts.scope_guard: Valuation method and floor-area basis do not identify site area, title extent or planning entitlement.

facts.calculation: price per square metre multiplied by relevant floor area
facts.scope_guard: NIA is usable internal building area and is not candidate land area or a property sale valuation.
GIA is internal building measurement and is not the legal parcel, site area or developable footprint.

facts.hereditament: unit of non-domestic rateable property appearing as a separate rating-list entry
facts.scope_guard: A hereditament is a rating unit and may not correspond one-to-one with an HMLR title, building, planning unit or candidate parcel.

scope_guards: The 2026 rating list effective date and 2024 antecedent valuation date remain distinct.
Rateable value estimates annual rental value for rating purposes and is not actual rent, bill, sale price or residual land value.
A hereditament is a rating-list assessment unit and is not automatically an HMLR title, building or candidate parcel.
NIA is usable internal floor area and is not site area, gross development area or title extent.
GIA is internal building area and is not legal parcel geometry or developable footprint.
Property-type rating classification is not planning use permission or evidence of lawful redevelopment.
Search, comparison and valuation-calculation services do not prove a candidate-specific title or spatial join.
No score or promotion is written without exact hereditament, address, UPRN, HMLR title, site and planning reconciliation.
